title: wave start launches without --yes when stdin is not a terminal

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Observed 2026-11-11 (slicer wave): `ork wave start slicer s454 s455 s450 s456 s451 --implementer claude:sonnet:high --reviewer grok:grok-4.7:medium --architect off </dev/null` (no --yes) printed nothing for 60 s and was killed by timeout; `ork status` then showed run-20261111-170605-e94e active with a spec-check running. The same command before the project had a check command printed the plan and refused. Expected: without --yes and with no terminal to confirm on, print the plan and exit without launching (or refuse), never launch silently.
